groups.name: xtrmetl
groups.description: mightyETL application-specific properties (config prefix remains xtrmetl for compatibility).

properties.name: xtrmetl.cdc.autostart
properties.description: Whether to automatically start CDC on application startup. Aliased from mightyetl.cdc.autostart when set.

properties.name: xtrmetl.cdc.canonical-map-enabled
properties.description: When true, map Debezium events to CanonicalChangeRecord for status counters; Kafka payload stays raw.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable replica apply pipeline.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.tables
properties.description: Comma-separated replica tables with (id, data) shape. Default: processed_data.

properties.name: mightyetl.cdc.autostart
properties.description: Preferred mightyETL prefix; mirrored onto xtrmetl.cdc.autostart.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.group-id
properties.description: Kafka consumer group id for the replica pipeline.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.ddl-enabled
properties.description: Whether to apply DDL events to the replica DB. Disabled by default.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.ddl-validation-mode
properties.description: DDL validation mode (whitelist|blocklist|none). The secure default is whitelist.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.ddl-allowed-prefixes
properties.description: Comma-separated DDL prefixes allowed when validation-mode=whitelist.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.ddl-blocked-prefixes
properties.description: Comma-separated DDL prefixes blocked when validation-mode=blocklist.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.kafka.concurrency
properties.description: Kafka listener concurrency for the replica consumer.

properties.name: xtrmetl.replica.kafka.retry-max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts for failed replica apply.

values.description: Allow only configured prefixes. This is the secure default.
Explicitly disable DDL validation. Not recommended.
